title: The Eve
setting: The night after Ugadi. Your flat. Anika is on your balcony, looking at the street. The city sounds different from up here — softer. You haven't told her about the offer from your old company. Bangalore. Or back. She turns when you come out with two coffees.

beats.native: Ee speech — ನಿಜವಾಗಿ ಒಳ್ಳೆಯದು ಆಗಿತ್ತು. Amma cried after you left. Appa ಒಂದು ಸಲ ಮಾತ್ರ ಎಲ್ಲರ ಜೊತೆ smile ಮಾಡ್ತಾರೆ — ನಿನ್ನೆ ನೋಡಿದೆ.
beats.translit: ee speech — nijavāgi oḷḷeyadu āgittu. Amma cried after you left. Appa ondu sala mātra ellara joḍe smile māḍtāre — ninne nōḍide.
beats.en: That speech — was actually good. Amma cried after you left. Appa smiles in front of everyone maybe once a year — saw it last night.
beats.beat: she takes the coffee. doesn't sip yet.

beats.prompt: You stand next to her, looking out. You say:

choices.native: Anika — ಒಂದು ವಿಷಯ ಹೇಳಬೇಕು. ಮೊದಲ company — ಮನೆಯ ಊರಿನಲ್ಲಿ — offer ಬಂದಿದೆ. Senior role. ನಾನು ಇನ್ನು decide ಮಾಡಿಲ್ಲ.
choices.translit: Anika — ondu viṣaya hēḷabēku. modala company — maneya ūrinalli — offer bandide. senior role. nānu innu decide māḍilla.
choices.en: Anika — there's something to tell you. My old company — back home — sent an offer. Senior role. I haven't decided yet.
I've been meaning to tell you something. Old company in my hometown sent an offer.

beats.native: ನಾನು ಗೊತ್ತಿತ್ತು ಒಂದು ಏನೋ ಇದೆ ಅಂತಾ. Two weeks ಆದರೆ ನೀನು ಯಾವತ್ತಾದರೂ phone ಮುಗಿಸಿ ಬರ್ತಾ ಇದ್ದೆ — face ಬೇರೆ ಆಗಿತ್ತು.
beats.translit: nānu gottittu ondu ēnō ide antā. two weeks ādare nīnu yāvattādarū phone mugisi bartā idde — face bēre āgittu.
beats.en: I knew something was up. For two weeks you'd come back from a call with a different face.

beats.prompt: You give her the number. You say:

choices.native: ಇಲ್ಲಿ ಗಿಂತ ಎರಡು ಪಟ್ಟು. ಆದರೆ ಊರು ಚಿಕ್ಕ. ಎಲ್ಲ familiar — ಆದರೆ ಎಲ್ಲ familiar.
choices.translit: illi ginta eraḍu paṭṭu. ādare ūru cikka. ella familiar — ādare ella familiar.
choices.en: Twice what I make here. But the town is small. Everything familiar — and everything familiar.
Twice this. But it's home. Small town. Comfortable.

beats.native: ನಿನ್ನ choice. ನಿಜವಾಗಿ. ನಾನು ಎಲ್ಲಿಗೆ ಬರಲ್ಲ — ee ಬೆಂಗಳೂರು ನನ್ನ ಊರು. ಆದರೆ ನಿನ್ನ choice ನಲ್ಲಿ ನಾನು ಒಂದು variable ಇರಬೇಕು — ಅಷ್ಟೇ ಕೇಳ್ತೀನಿ.
beats.translit: ninna choice. nijavāgi. nānu ellige baralla — ee Beṅgaḷūru nanna ūru. ādare ninna choice-nalli nānu ondu variable irabēku — aṣṭē kēḷtīni.
beats.en: Your choice. Really. I'm not coming anywhere — Bangalore is my home. But I should be one variable in your decision — that's all I'm asking.
beats.beat: she finally sips. holds the cup with both hands.

choices.native: ಒಂದು variable ಅಲ್ಲ Anika. ತುಂಬಾ ದೊಡ್ಡ variable. ನಾಳೆ ಬೆಳಿಗ್ಗೆ — decide ಮಾಡ್ತೀನಿ.
choices.translit: ondu variable alla Anika. tumbā doḍḍa variable. nāḷe beḷigge — decide māḍtīni.
choices.en: Not one variable, Anika. A very big variable. Tomorrow morning — I'll decide.
You're more than a variable, Anika. I'll decide tomorrow.

beats.en: Okay. Tomorrow morning. The Pongamia, right?
beats.beat: the smallest small smile. the cup, halfway to her face, pauses.
